values.title: A shipment is late by more than two days

provenance.quote: In a chase email, state how many days past the promised date the goods are, but only when that is over two.
Een levering die langer dan twee dagen te laat is, krijgt a phone call, not a mail.
Treat a parcel as overdue for the digest once it is past its date by more than 48 hours.
A parcel more than two working days late gets a second email.

values.title: A shipment is late by more than one day

provenance.quote: Mention the delay in the subject line whenever the delivery is more than a day late.
Past one day of delay, replace the ETA line with the new date from the carrier.
A delivery that is not even one day behind schedule stays out of the late table; a longer delay goes in.

values.title: A shipment is lost

provenance.quote: Never ask a supplier to speed up a delivery that the carrier has declared lost.

values.title: The report has no late shipments

provenance.quote: When the report has no late shipments, write none under that heading.

values.title: A shipment is exactly two days late

provenance.quote: When a shipment is exactly two days late, send the reminder, not the escalation.

values.title: The session was just compacted

provenance.quote: Following a compaction of the conversation, list the open questions again before you answer.

values.title: The session was just restarted

provenance.quote: Directly after a restart, reopen the last draft instead of writing a new one.

values.title: The session was just forked from an older one

provenance.quote: After the session is forked from an older one, read the tracker note first.

values.title: The session was just compacted twice in a row

provenance.quote: When the session has just been compacted twice in a row, ask the user to start a new one.

variables.title: The work done on an invoice

values.title: An invoice file is about to be edited

provenance.quote: Do not suggest a correction to an invoice file that someone is about to edit.
The report never edits an invoice; if it ever must, read the matching rules the moment before.

values.title: The total difference of an invoice is above 50.00 EUR

provenance.quote: Skip the extra review whenever the total difference stays at or under 50.00 EUR; above it, ask for one.
If the total difference on the invoice exceeds fifty (50) euros, link the shipment log in the note.

values.title: An invoice is about to be deleted

provenance.quote: Voordat de factuur wordt verwijderd, ask the user once.

values.title: A single invoice line differs by more than 50 EUR

provenance.quote: If one invoice line alone differs by more than 50 EUR, mark that line.

values.title: An invoice is older than 30 days

provenance.quote: When an invoice is older than 30 days, put it first in the list.

variables.title: Work handed to a helper agent

values.title: A helper agent is about to be dispatched

provenance.quote: Each time you are about to dispatch a helper, check that its brief states the answer shape.

values.title: A helper agent died

provenance.quote: A helper agent that was killed by a timeout counts as dead; do not build on its partial output.
When the ledger auditor dies in the middle of a check, report that and offer to run it again.

values.title: A helper agent is named in the routing table

provenance.quote: When a helper agent is named in the routing table, use its exact name.

values.title: A helper agent was dispatched twice for the same invoice

provenance.quote: When a helper agent was dispatched twice for the same invoice, stop the second one.

variables.title: An approval the agent waits for

values.title: A person whose approval is needed has not answered

provenance.quote: If the manager stays silent on the credit note, keep it as a draft and ask again tomorrow.

values.title: A person gave an explicit yes

provenance.quote: With an explicit yes from the user in hand, the email may be sent without another question.
Zodra de eigenaar ja heeft gezegd, apply the correction and show the result.
A manager who answered yes in writing counts as approval; proceed and note who said it.

values.title: A supplier is not in the language table

provenance.quote: A supplier that you cannot find in this table is written to in English.
If the supplier has no row in supplier-languages.md, say so to the user and use English.

values.title: A supplier is in the language table
A supplier has two languages listed

provenance.quote: When a supplier has two languages listed, write in the first one.

values.title: The carrier answers with an error

provenance.quote: Do not retry a tracking call by hand when the carrier has answered with an error; report it.
Mark a shipment unknown, not late, when the carrier's reply was an error.

values.title: The carrier answers with a status
The carrier answers with a status and an error in the same reply

provenance.quote: When the carrier answers with a status and an error in the same reply, show both.
